title: OpenPlanr .pipeline-shipped marker (v1.0.0)
description: JSON Schema for the YAML completion marker written by SHIP at the end of every successful (or partially-successful) run. Path: output/feats/feat-{name}/.pipeline-shipped (default mode) or .planr/specs/SPEC-NNN-{slug}/.pipeline-shipped (spec-driven mode). Note: this artifact uses `pipeline_version` (the planr-pipeline plugin semver) rather than a `schemaVersion` field; the schema-version of the marker is encoded in the file path itself (schemas/v1.0.0/...).

shipped_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which SHIP completed.

pipeline_version.description: Semver of the planr-pipeline plugin that produced the marker (e.g. 0.7.3).

runtime.description: Runtime adapter that executed this turn (NEW in v1.0.0).

feature.description: Feature name (default mode) or spec slug (spec-driven mode).

tasks_executed.description: Number of tasks executed during this SHIP run.

tasks_failed.description: Number of tasks that failed (after the 3-iteration correction loop).

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock duration of the SHIP run in whole seconds.

agents_invoked.description: List of role names that actually ran during this SHIP turn. Order is informational.

devops_status.description: Whether devops-agent produced artifacts this turn.

docs_status.description: Whether doc-gen-agent produced artifacts this turn.

snapshot_status.description: Whether the codebase snapshot was refreshed this turn.

error_reports.description: Relative or absolute repo paths for any **`T-<NNN>-error-report.md`** handoffs produced after R6 caps. Legacy singleton `tasks/error-report.md` is forbidden.
